Class TomlTable.Builder

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.toml.TomlTable.Builder
Enclosing class:
TomlTable
public static final class TomlTable.Builder extends Object
Builds a TomlTable, keeping its entries in the order they are put.
Since:
0.1.0

    • put

      public TomlTable.Builder put(String key, TomlValue value)
      Puts an entry, replacing the value of a key that is already in the table but keeping its position.
      Parameters:
      key - the key, taken as is: a dot is part of the key and does not nest tables
      value - the value
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if key or value is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if key contains an unpaired surrogate
